(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method comprising: receiving a plurality of precoders from a codebook in a transmitter having an antenna array; transforming each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is __substantially balanced__ to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form with respect to the corresponding precoder, where the quadratic form is based on a transmission line impedance of a transmission line between a signal source and the antenna array; receiving a signal from the signal source; applying a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel; and transmitting the precoded signal.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array and a matching network.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and __the__ length of the transmission line.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of a transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied, ensuring that each transformed precoder achieves __similar__ transmit power.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method according to claim 1, wherein the transformation equalizes the transmit power for all of the plurality of precoders __by balancing the power levels produced by each precoder__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method according to claim 1, wherein transforming transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when __more than one transmission line is used__ between a source of the signal and the antenna array.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method according to claim 1, wherein both data symbol precoders and reference symbol precoders are transformed by the same transformation, thereby maintaining consistency across the precoders. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The method according to claim 1, wherein the controller transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders when __multiple transmission lines are connected__ between a source of the signal and the antenna array.
